summary: In src/sensei_top/logs.py I added class _Level(logging.Filter) (stores floor; passes records >= floor, plus INFO records whose name is exactly sensei_top.llm or starts with 'sensei_top.llm.'). In install I changed the console handler to setLevel(INFO) with _Level(WARNING if verbose else ERROR), and the file handler to setLevel(DEBUG if verbose else INFO), adding _Level(WARNING) only when not verbose and only after file_handler.handle(_header(...)) so the header survives. Root level stays min(handler.level). I also updated the docstring's Levels bullet. Both required commands pass: pytest 32 passed, ruff clean.
concerns: Confirm the _Level filter sits after the header write but before any other records reach the file handler.
